## Data Model Signals

### Entity: `custom_field`
| Field | Type | Notes from screen |
|-------|------|-------------------|
| `id` | integer/UUID | Internal identifier; not shown |
| `name` | string | "Recently Divorced", "Enrichment Provider", "Phone Type", etc. |
| `type` | enum | `text`, `number`, `date` — likely also `dropdown`, `checkbox`, `url` (not visible in this scroll) |
| `people_count` | integer | Count of contact records with this field populated; denormalized or computed on-the-fly |
| `hide_if_empty` | boolean | Whether field is hidden on contact profile when null/empty |
| `read_only` | boolean | Whether field can be edited by end users vs. only via API/import |
| `display_order` | integer | Controls sort order in this list; changed via drag-and-drop |
| `account_id` | FK | Links to the FUB account (here: Ryan Realty account ID 2, inferred from `/2/` in URL path) |

### Entity: `custom_field_value` (junction / values table)
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `person_id` | FK | Links to a contact record |
| `custom_field_id` | FK | Links to custom_field |
| `value` | string | The actual value stored (polymorphic for Text/Number/Date types, or cast on read) |

### Relationships
- `Account` has many `custom_field` (64 in this case)
- `Person` (contact) has many `custom_field_value` through `custom_field`
- The "People" count column = `COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) WHERE custom_field_id = X AND value IS NOT NULL`

### Enum values observed for `type`
- `Text`
- `Number`
- `Date`
- (Others likely exist: Dropdown, Checkbox, URL, Phone — not visible in viewport)

### Account path segment
- URL pattern `/2/custom-fields` — the `2` is the account ID. All FUB routes appear to be `/{{accountId}}/{{section}}`.

```
<AdminLayout>
  <TopNavBar>
    <AppSwitcherIcon />
    <NavItem icon="people" label="People" href="/people" />
    <NavItem icon="inbox" label="Inbox" href="/inbox" badge={notificationCount} />
    <NavItem icon="tasks" label="Tasks" href="/tasks" />
    <NavItem icon="calendar" label="Calendar" href="/calendar" />
    <NavItem icon="deals" label="Deals" href="/deals" />
    <NavItem icon="reporting" label="Reporting" href="/reporting" />
    <NavItem icon="admin" label="Admin" href="/admin" active={true} />
    <SearchBar placeholder="Search" />
    <UtilityIcons>
      <IconButton icon="email" />
      <IconButton icon="sms" />
      <IconButton icon="add-contact" />
      <NotificationBell count={n} />
      <UserAvatarMenu label="Ryan Realty" />
    </UtilityIcons>
  </TopNavBar>

  <AdminSubNav activeTab="custom-fields">
    <SubNavTab label="Overview" href="/admin/overview" />
    <SubNavTab label="Lead Flow" href="/admin/lead-flow" />
    <SubNavTab label="Groups" href="/admin/groups" />
    <SubNavTab label="Team" href="/admin/team" />
    <SubNavTab label="Action Plans" href="/admin/action-plans" />
    <SubNavTab label="Automations" href="/admin/automations" />
    <SubNavTab label="Ponds" href="/admin/ponds" />
    <SubNavTab label="Email Templates" href="/admin/email-templates" />
    <SubNavTab label="Text Templates" href="/admin/text-templates" />
    <SubNavTab label="Import" href="/admin/import" />
    <SubNavTab label="Custom Fields" href="/admin/custom-fields" active={true} />
    <SubNavTab label="Stages" href="/admin/stages" />
    <SubNavTab label="Phone Numbers" href="/admin/phone-numbers" />
    <SubNavTab label="Tags" href="/admin/tags" />
    <SubNavTab label="Integrations" href="/admin/integrations" />
    <SubNavTab label="Company" href="/admin/company" />
    <SubNavTab label="API" href="/admin/api" />
    <SubNavTab label="More" dropdown={true} />
    <HelpLink icon="info" label="How Custom Fields work" href={helpUrl} />
  </AdminSubNav>

  <PageContent>
    <PageHeader>
      <h1>64 Custom Fields</h1>
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={openAddModal}>Add Custom Field</Button>
    </PageHeader>

    <CustomFieldsTable
      fields={fields}           // array of 64 custom_field objects
      onReorder={handleReorder} // drag-and-drop callback
    >
      <TableHeader>
        <th></th>  {/* drag handle col */}
        <th>Field Name</th>
        <th>Type</th>
        <th>People</th>
        <th>Hide if empty <Tooltip text="..." /></th>
        <th>Read-only <Tooltip text="..." /></th>
        <th>Action</th>
      </TableHeader>

      {fields.map(field => (
        <CustomFieldRow
          key={field.id}
          field={field}
          onEdit={() => openEditModal(field)}
          onDelete={() => openDeleteConfirm(field)}
          onToggleHideIfEmpty={handleToggle}
          onToggleReadOnly={handleToggle}
        >
          <DragHandle />
          <td>{field.name}</td>
          <td>{field.type}</td>
          <td>
            {field.peopleCount > 0
              ? <Link href={`/people?customField=${field.id}`}>{field.peopleCount}</Link>
              : <span>0</span>
            }
          </td>
          <td><Checkbox checked={field.hideIfEmpty} /></td>
          <td><Checkbox checked={field.readOnly} /></td>
          <td>
            <IconButton icon="edit" />
            <IconButton icon="trash" />
          </td>
        </CustomFieldRow>
      ))}
    </CustomFieldsTable>
  </PageContent>

  <HelpWidget /> {/* Intercom floating button */}
</AdminLayout>
```

### Non-obvious implementation notes

1. **Drag-to-reorder:** The drag handle (⠿ 6-dot grid) implies the table uses a drag-and-drop library (e.g., react-dnd, dnd-kit, or Sortable.js). On drop, the new order is persisted via a PATCH/PUT API call with the updated `display_order` for all affected rows (or a batch reorder endpoint).

2. **People count as navigation:** The People count column doubles as a filter link — clicking the blue number navigates to `/people?customField={id}` (or similar filter param) to show all contacts who have this field populated. Zero counts are intentionally non-clickable (plain text, not a link) since filtering for 0 populated contacts would be unusual/empty.

3. **"Hide if empty" behavior:** When enabled, this field does not render at all on a contact's profile card/sidebar when the value is null/empty. Without it, the field renders with an empty dash or placeholder.

4. **"Read-only" behavior:** When enabled, agents cannot type into this field on a contact profile. It would render as disabled/greyed input. Values can still be set by admin via import, API, or data enrichment integrations.

5. **"Include In FB CAS" field (7,255 people):** "FB CAS" likely refers to Facebook Custom Audience Sync — a custom field used to flag which contacts should be synced to a Facebook Custom Audience for ad targeting.

6. **Account ID in URL path:** The `/2/` segment in the URL indicates this is a multi-tenant app where each account/team has a numeric ID. All API routes likely follow pattern `/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/custom-fields`.

7. **Total count display ("64 Custom Fields"):** This count should update reactively when a field is added or deleted, without a full page reload.

8. **Tooltip on "Hide if empty" and "Read-only" headers:** The `?` circle icons indicate a `<Tooltip>` component that appears on hover, explaining what the toggle does. The tooltip should be accessible (aria-label or role="tooltip").

9. **Type enum for "Add Custom Field" modal:** Though only Text, Number, and Date are visible in this viewport, FUB likely supports: Text, Number, Date, Dropdown (single select), Checkbox (boolean), URL, and possibly Multi-select. The modal's Type dropdown would expose all options.

10. **Scroll behavior:** The table scrolls vertically within the main content area. The top nav bar and sub-nav bar are sticky/fixed (do not scroll). The table header row should also be sticky within the scrollable area.

11. **Row alternation:** No alternating row colors visible — rows use white backgrounds with light horizontal dividers only (no zebra striping).

12. **"More ▾" sub-nav tab:** This dropdown likely contains additional admin sections that don't fit in the horizontal tab bar at standard viewport widths (e.g., Billing, Webhooks, SSO, etc.).
